purpose: M7: a footnote's own page reference can change its typeset extent and page placement
mechanism: M7 footnote placement feedback through the typeset width of a resolved page reference
why_undetected: Footnote layout is outside the declared subset, so the footnote command makes the document opaque before its extent feedback can be classified.
notes: The note labels its own page near a page boundary. UNKNOWN is an explicit fallback, not a claimed false negative; dynamic measurement must establish whether this threshold oscillates.
